bullet_points: Load the halo_catalog_XX.npy and galaxy_catalog_XX.npy files for all 10 realizations.
Compute R_vir for each halo using R_vir = (3 M_vir / (4 pi * 200 * rho_crit))^(1/3), where rho_crit is derived from the provided cosmological parameters.
Match satellite galaxies to host halos using the ln_M_h column in the galaxy catalog.
Group satellites by host halo mass bin and compute the 3D periodic distance from the host center, normalized by R_vir.
Print the number of qualifying halos (M > 10^13 M_sun/h) and satellites found per realization.
Compute the empirical mean density profile n(r/R_vir|M_vir) and perform a Kolmogorov-Smirnov test against the theoretical exponential profile e^(-r/R_vir).
Save the aggregated results to a file.
Estimate the empirical Void Probability Function P_0(r) using Monte Carlo random sphere placement (at least 5,000 random centers per radius).
Use a logarithmically spaced grid of at least 15 radius values between 1 and 30 Mpc/h.
Implement the Poisson-cluster approximation to calculate the theoretical P_0(r) based on halo number density and satellite occupation probability.
Save the empirical and theoretical P_0(r) values to a file.
Compute the 2PCF xi(r) for empirical catalogs using the Landy-Szalay estimator on a fine logarithmic grid (15 bins, 0.5–20 Mpc/h) with a random catalog 5x larger than the data.
Construct a "decoupled" model using the same halo centers and satellite counts, but re-drawing satellite positions from the theoretical exponential profile.
Compute the 2PCF for the decoupled model.
Calculate the relative difference Delta_xi/xi and determine r_crit where the bias falls within 1-sigma error bars.
Compute the 3PCF zeta(r_1, r_2, theta) for 3–5 equilateral and 2–3 squeezed triangle configurations (1–10 Mpc/h).
Use a direct triplet-counting approach with a KD-tree/ball-tree for efficiency.
Limit the sample size to 1–2 realizations if necessary to ensure completion within the 1800s timeout.
Compute the 3PCF for the decoupled model and save results to a file.
Define the luminosity mark as the difference between satellite ln L and its host central galaxy's ln L.
Compute the marked correlation function M(r) for r < 5 Mpc/h.
Calculate Pearson and Spearman rank correlations between the luminosity mark and normalized satellite-centric distance.
Save the results to a file.
Aggregate all metrics (KS statistics, VPF residuals, r_crit, 3PCF amplitudes, marked correlation values) across 10 realizations.
Construct and print the full sample covariance matrix to the console.
Generate a single multi-panel summary figure (radial profile, VPF, Delta_xi/xi, 3PCF, marked correlation) with error bars and save as a high-resolution PNG.
Write the full Results section of the scientific report.
Include quantitative citations for all key metrics (KS p-values, VPF residuals, r_crit, 3PCF ratios, marked correlation peaks, covariance diagonals).
Structure the report with subsections corresponding to each analysis step.
Provide a definitive assessment of the HOD's spatial and luminosity implementation accuracy.
